payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates tx from d+1 to t1-1, computes total cakes by time tx from both ovens, returns YES if n cakes achieved before t1, else NO.
payload.rationale: The algorithm exhaustively searches over possible finish times, using an upper bound (t1) and early exit when condition met. While not a classic branch-and-bound with recursion and lower bounds, it best matches the provided branch_and_bound subtype among the limited complete_search options.
